sources.title: AI in Mahjong: Bots, Training Tools, and Strategy
sources.snippet: Modern AI mahjong tools and training bots can now analyze hands, predict safer discards, identify strategic mistakes, and help players improve faster than ever before. Whether you play American mahjong with NMJL cards, riichi online, or classical Chinese mahjong, AI is beginning to reshape how players study and understand the game.
